skill_name: Describe how machine learning can improve cybersecurity.
workflow: Machine learning can be used to quickly detect and respond to cybersecurity threats by analyzing large volumes of data to identify patterns and detect anomalies in network behavior. Machine learning algorithms can also be used to detect malware and zero-day attacks, as well as aid in incident response by predicting where an attack may occur and responding quickly. Additionally, machine learning can be used to detect malicious activities such as phishing attacks and suspicious network activity. B
